get.description: ID-mapping agent statistics: coverage per platform, the last write and the last hour's rate, hourly resolve/exclude counts for the past 24 hours, and every worker's heartbeat. With `sections=details` it returns the heavy sections instead: the paginated audit log, the per-agent breakdown, exclusions grouped by platform, and the 50 most recent runs.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: `details` for the audit log, agent breakdown, exclusions and run history. Anything else, or omitted, returns the summary.

parameters.name: auditPage
parameters.description: Audit log page, from 1. Only with `sections=details`. A value that isn't a number is read as 1.

parameters.name: auditLimit
parameters.description: Audit log entries per page, clamped to 1–200. Only with `sections=details`. A value that isn't a number is read as 50.

200.description: The summary, or the details when `sections=details`.

exclusions.details: Three Deezer artists share the name.

get.description: Artist data coverage: how many artists exist and have a Spotify ID, platform-ID coverage with today's count, link coverage per platform (today's count comes from MCP writes only), the distribution of how many tracked fields each artist has, and enrichment readiness.

200.description: The catalog summary; a repeat call within 30 seconds may return the same numbers.

patch.description: Marks a pending About correction report `resolved` or `dismissed`, recording who reviewed it and when. A report that was already reviewed is not changed. To fix the About itself, use [Save the About for a report](/api-reference/admin/save-correction-about), which resolves the report as part of the save.

400.description: `id` isn't a UUID, or `status` isn't `resolved` or `dismissed`.

409.description: The report was already reviewed, or there is no report with that ID.

example.error: Report was already reviewed or does not exist

get.summary: Read the About for a report
get.description: The About currently published for the artist a pending correction report is about, with a `revision` hash to send back on save. For a claimed artist that is their own About; for an unclaimed one, the public directory About.

200.description: The published About and its revision.

example.bio: Bio Ritmo is a 10-piece salsa band from Richmond, Virginia.

409.description: The report was already reviewed or no longer exists, the About is pinned (unpin it on the artist profile first), or the published About is no longer available.

value.error: This report has already been reviewed or no longer exists.
This About is pinned. Unpin it on the artist profile before editing.
The published About is no longer available. Review the artist profile before resolving this report.

500.description: The About could not be read.

example.error: Could not load the current About. Try again.

put.summary: Save the About for a report
put.description: Replaces the artist's published About and resolves the report in one step, keeping the old text in the artist's bio history and recording an `about_edited` activity. `revision` must match what [Read the About for a report](/api-reference/admin/get-correction-about) returned; if the About or the artist's ownership changed since, nothing is saved and the response is 409.

bio.description: The new About. Trimmed; up to 10,000 characters.

example.bio: Bio Ritmo is a 10-piece salsa orchestra from Richmond, Virginia, formed in 1991.

200.description: The About is saved and the report resolved.

400.description: `id` isn't a UUID, or the body isn't a non-empty `bio` of up to 10,000 characters with a 64-hex-character `revision`.

value.error: Enter a valid About and reload the editor if needed.

409.description: The save was refused: the revision no longer matches, the report was reviewed meanwhile, the About is pinned, or the published About is no longer available. The draft is not saved.

example.error: The About or artist ownership changed. Your draft is kept; cancel and reopen the editor to review the latest version.

500.description: The save could not be confirmed.

example.error: Could not confirm the save. Your draft is kept; refresh the queue before retrying.

get.description: Every MCP API key, newest first, including revoked ones. Only the first 8 characters of each key's hash are returned; the key itself is shown once, on creation. The response is a bare array, not this API's `{ status }` envelope.

post.description: Creates an MCP API key with a label and returns the key. This is the only time the key is shown; only its hash is stored.

label.description: What the key is for. Trimmed.

201.description: The new key. Copy it now.

rawKey.description: 64 hex characters (32 random bytes). Not stored; cannot be shown again.

post.description: Revokes an MCP API key: it stops authenticating immediately and stays listed with its `revokedAt`. A key that is already revoked, or doesn't exist, is 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The key's ID (a UUID), from the list.

404.description: No active key with that ID: it doesn't exist or was already revoked.

put.description: Updates a user's wallet, email, user name or role flags; only the fields sent are changed, and `null` clears `wallet` or `email`. Making someone an admin also whitelists them, and `isWhiteListed` is ignored in that same request. A user name must be 1–50 characters, not an email or wallet address, and not taken (case-insensitive); a refused name fails the whole update.

wallet.description: The wallet address, or `null` to clear it.

email.description: The email, or `null` to clear it.

username.description: The user name. Saved as confirmed.

400.description: `id` isn't a UUID, a field has the wrong type, no field was sent, or the update was refused (for example a taken user name).

get.description: How many user-submitted links are waiting for admin review. A caller who is not signed in or not an admin gets `count: 0` rather than an error, and so does a database failure.

200.description: The count; 0 for anyone who isn't an admin.

admin.summary: An admin with three links to review

other.summary: Not signed in, or not an admin

adminBearer.description: A Music Nerd admin's access token. Copy it at https://musicnerd.net/access after signing in. A signed-in user who is not an admin gets 403.

NotSignedIn.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, or no Music Nerd user for it.

NotAdmin.description: The user is not an admin.

InternalError.description: The database could not be read or written.

platform.description: One of the mapping platforms: `deezer`, `apple_music`, `musicbrainz`, `wikidata`, `tidal`, `amazon_music`, `youtube_music`, `genius`, `allmusic`, `billboard`, `rolling_stone`. Every platform is listed, mapped or not.

percentage.description: Of artists with a Spotify ID, to two decimals.

todayCount.description: Mappings created since midnight, database time.

apiKeyHash.description: The full SHA-256 hash of the worker's MCP key.

computedStatus.description: `dead` when the heartbeat is older than the worker's `batchTimeout` (900 s by default) plus 120 s.

lastWriteAt.description: The newest MCP audit log entry, or `null` when there is none.

rateLastHour.description: Distinct artists written to by MCP in the last hour.

hourlyActivity.description: The last 24 hours, oldest first; hours with no writes are absent.

workers.description: Every worker heartbeat, most recently updated first.

agentLabel.description: The MCP key's label, or `null` when the key no longer exists.

agents.description: One row per MCP key that resolved or excluded a mapping, most resolved first.

platforms.description: Keyed by platform; only platforms with exclusions appear. Up to 500 exclusions each, newest first.

runs.description: The 50 most recent runs, newest first.

platformIdCoverage.description: From `artist_id_mappings`, most mapped first. Only platforms with at least one mapping appear.

artistLinkCoverage.description: One row per tracked column, in a fixed order: instagram, bluesky, x, facebook, tiktok, youtube, youtubechannel, soundcloud, bandcamp, subvert, discogs, lastfm, musicbrainz, wikidata, imdb, wikipedia, bio, linkedin, farcaster, twitch, patreon. Spotify is left out because it is the denominator elsewhere.

todayCount.description: Distinct artists whose column MCP `set` since midnight. Manual edits and UGC approvals are not counted.

completenessDistribution.description: How many of the tracked columns each artist has filled, bucketed `0-1`, `2-3`, `4-6`, `7-10`, `11+`; empty buckets are absent.

revision.description: A SHA-256 over the artist, its claim and the About. Send it back on save.

keyHashPrefix.description: The first 8 characters of the key's SHA-256 hash, for telling keys apart.
